title: quercus lanuginosa subsp. cerrioides
intro: Quercus lanuginosa subsp. cerrioides, commonly known as the "Chinese White Oak" or "Chinese Cork Oak", is a subspecies of evergreen tree native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Quercus lanuginosa subsp. cerrioides include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe coughs and relieve congestion. Its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and triterpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal effects, which also include antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
